headline: Digital wealth platform drove 32% engagement lift and 2,400 new HNW relationships
challenge: Legacy systems and fragmented client experience were eroding competitive position against digital-native challengers in the UHNW segment.
approach: Deployed our Digital Maturity Assessment to benchmark capabilities, then designed a phased transformation roadmap prioritizing client-facing digital touchpoints and advisor enablement tools.

headline: Portfolio ROIC improved from 11.2% to 16.8% through disciplined rationalization
challenge: Sprawling multi-division portfolio with uneven returns was masking the performance of core growth platforms and suppressing total shareholder return versus specialty chemicals peer index.
approach: Applied growth-share matrix analysis across all divisions, then executed a staged divestiture of non-core units while reinvesting proceeds into high-growth adjacencies.

headline: Acquisition closed at 12% below initial valuation with $45M year-one synergies
challenge: Board sought to acquire a complementary therapeutic pipeline to diversify revenue concentration risk, but lacked in-house M&A capability and faced competitive bidding from larger strategic acquirers.
approach: Conducted comprehensive commercial due diligence on pipeline assets, built proprietary probability-adjusted DCF models, and supported negotiation strategy to secure exclusivity at favorable terms.

headline: Growth reignited to 34% YoY through segmentation-led GTM transformation
challenge: Growth had decelerated as the company's undifferentiated GTM motion struggled to penetrate enterprise accounts, threatening IPO timeline and valuation targets.
approach: Deployed jobs-to-be-done segmentation to identify high-propensity enterprise buyer personas, redesigned pricing architecture, and restructured sales organization around vertical specialization.
